Messages.Author: acbishop
Messages.Body:
Vampire VA controlled by player A is bleeding for 1 player B.
Vampire VB controlled by player B plays Telepathic Counter at superior to reduce the bleed by 2.

Can vampire VA play a Conditioning at inferior now?
1) Yes, the total of the bleed is 2
2) Yes, the total of the bleed is 1 (CORRECT)
3) No, the bleed has already been modified by other card and Conditioning has the (limited) text

Relevant cardtexts:
Name: Telepathic Counter
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Auspex
[aus] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[AUS] Reduce a bleed against you by 2.

Name: Conditioning
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Dominate
Only usable during a bleed action.
[dom] +2 bleed (limited).
[DOM] +3 bleed (limited).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Answer 2)
Total = 1 - 2 + 2 = 1

The limited rule applies only to action modifier cards that increase the bleed.
